## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Goshen, United States. It starts at One LEGOLAND Blvd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> LEGOLAND New York Resort is more than an amusement park. With seven themed lands set across 150 acres, it's like stepping into another world.
>
> The park is home to many rides, shows, and attractions. There are thrilling, kid-friendly rollercoasters as well as a host of LEGO workshops, a 4D cinema, and much more! Block out the day, and get lost in New York's enormously vibrant world of LEGO.
>
> Visit the LEGO® DUPLO® PEPPA PIG Playground where the popular world of PEPPA PIG is merged with the LEGO DUPLO universe in a play area.
>
> Meet Peppa and George on their puppet theater stage. Explore Peppa’s tree house, the slide, and the muddy puddles. Also, you can hop aboard Grandpa Pig’s boat.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €55.95. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 43 ratings and 30 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
